# KRCW: the West Coast after the civil war (generated by build/am_p22_reunification.py)
on_actions = {
	on_monthly_USA = {
		effect = { krcw_reun_monthly = yes }
	}
	on_monthly_WCA = {
		effect = { krcw_reun_monthly = yes }
	}
	# Sacramento capitulates in the war in the Rockies: the winner takes the West Coast
	on_capitulation = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = PSA
					has_global_flag = KRCW_reun_war
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_reun_done }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = KRCW_reun_by_wca country_exists = WCA }
					WCA = { country_event = { id = krcw_reun.22 days = 1 } }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = KRCW_reun_by_usa country_exists = USA }
					USA = { country_event = { id = krcw_reun.22 days = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
